gloss: brief; short and to the point

definitions.gloss: brief; short and to the point
definitions.explanation: Kept short, leaving out details, usually of speaking or explaining. Almost always used adverbially as {手短|てみじか}に.

examples.japanese: {手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}します→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain just the main points, briefly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We're short on time, so to put it briefly, the plan has been canceled.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ / ⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to speak / explain briefly
- {手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: to put it briefly, in short
- {手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いします: please keep it short (polite request)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: simply, briefly — the everyday word; {手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ stresses keeping talk short because time is limited
- ⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧: concise (of writing or a statement; more formal)
